newsitem.title: FINLAND: Pohjola says revises restructuring plan.
newsitem.headline: Pohjola says revises restructuring plan.

text.p: Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola, a Finnish insurer, said on Wednesday government authorities had not approved its planned restructuring into a holding company and Pohjola now intended to remain as an insurance company.

"Pohjola has changed its restructuring plan so that Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola remains an insurance company," it said, adding that the other parts of its restructuring announced on January 23 were unchanged.
The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health (STM) was of the opinion that Pohjola should remain subject to regular insurance sector supervision, Pohjola said.
Under current legislation, the ministry's authority to look into a holding company is more limited than into an insurance company, Pohjola said.

On January 23, Pohjola said it planned to become a holding company with two main subsidiaries; the non-life insurance business and the life-insurance business, which is currently managed by its associated company Suomi. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
